title: General.
officialText: The design of masonry structures using allowable stress design shall comply with Section 2106 and the requirements of Chapters 1 and 2, except Section 2.1.2.1 and 2.1.3.3 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5. The text of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5 shall be modified by Sections 2107.2 through 2107.5 of this code.
